name: Erica Synths LXR-02
description: Erica Synths LXR-02 six-voice digital drum synthesizer: every controller of its owner's manual's MIDI CC list and every parameter of its NRPN list.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/erica/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/erica/synths/, not this file.

Every parameter is a controller of the manual's MIDI chart, with the name it prints, grouped by the voice it belongs to. The chart prints no values: each is 0 - 127. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.
The controllers answer on the global MIDI channel (the channel variable); each voice's own channel, set beside it, is for its notes.
An NRPN is sent as the list's own controllers say: CC 99 (NRPN coarse) the number's upper half, always 0 here, CC 98 (NRPN fine) the number, CC 6 (NRPN data entry) the value.
Left out, the controllers the NRPN parameters are sent with: CC 6 NRPN data entry, CC 98 NRPN fine, CC 99 NRPN coarse.
Numbers the chart lists with no function (`-`), left out: CC 0, CC 1, NRPN 93, NRPN 94, NRPN 95, NRPN 96, NRPN 97, NRPN 98, NRPN 99, NRPN 116.

coverage.inboundControllers: the instrument sends controllers where its MIDI filter (mtx) lets Control Change through
